notes.title: Last part of the story update is here!
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

Final part of story is here. It was difficult and long way, but definitely satisfying one! This is one of the biggest updates yet, full of story quests, cutscenes and fun!

[b]The Northtown, Part 3[/b]
[list]
[*] The third and final part of the Northtown and main story
[*] Added side quests for City of Sun and Springfield
[*] New cutscenes and bossfights!
[*] New enemies (Zombie Firefighter, Zombie QB's Girlfriend)
[*] New encounter quests
[*] New karma quests
[*] New locations (Castle, Mountain hotel)
[*] New localization (Estonian, Italian)
[*] Game balancing
[*] Ton of bugfixes and tweaks
[/list]

We also recently added Trading Cards so you can enjoy a little bit of collecting frenzy. :-) 

We are finalizing plans for the future of the game. Story is finished, but we don't want to stop working on the game yet - we will let you know once we decide what will be the future of Walking Zombie 2. :-)

notes.title: Update released!
notes.content:
Hi,

we are here with information about update that was just released. It containts bugfixes and balances parts of the game. Work on second part of Northtown will still take more time so, please, be patient with us. :-)

[h2]Update contents[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgrade weapons in inventory
[*] Fixed falling through the floor
[*] Companions - Fixed low HP
[*] Ace - fixed bad quest generation
[*] Several minor bugs fixed
[*] Game balancing
[*] Problems with aiming (issue where you have to aim higher or lower to actually hit enemies) fixed
[*] Fixed being blocked by safe door
[/list]

notes.title: Northtown update released!
notes.content:
We thank each and every one of you for supporting development of the game. Creating new city always takes more time but you can expect the next update in about 2 months.

Together with the new update, we are also releasing DLC that is quite similar to the existing Steam pack in-app, but gives you more value and one unique car. It is not recommended to buy if you already have Steam Pack as features mostly overlap:  [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1221700/Walking_Zombie_2__Mega_Pack/]WALKING ZOMBIE 2 - MEGA PACK[/url][/b]

[h2]The Northtown, Part 1 (3.2.2)[/h2]
[list][*] First part of Northtown
[*] Quests, cutscenes, bossfights!
[*] New weapons (Laser kar 4000, Alien laser rifle)
[*] Redesigned skill system
[*] Circuit minigame hints
[*] Possibility to enlarge the weapon magazine
[*] New perks
[*] New localizations (Polish, Indonesian, Filipino)
[*] New books, skins, traps, enemies
[*] Nuclear armor cap refund
[*] Surgical mask in the game (EVERYONE needs to be protected right now)
[*] New system icons in global maps
[*] Exit button for Android
[*] Ball and shower in Woodlands :)
[*] New foods - Pasta, Peanut butter
[*] New books (Laser weapons, Advanced skills)
[*] Rebalance of rewards in treasure maps
[*] Balancing game - IronCleaner and others
[*] Changing the disposal behavior of a trap
[*] New marker for navigation in quests
[*] Weapon table nametag
[*] Bugfixes (around 475 issues solved)
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 3.0.7 released
notes.content:
Hi! 

We just released a small hotfix that gets rid of a few small bugs.
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with mortar
[*] Game balancing
[*] Removal of Twinkies from game
[*] Other small fixes
[/list]

We are working on a big update that will bring closure to the City of Sun part of the game with new quests, bosses, enemies, and weapons. In that update, we will also try to fix performance issues, add achievements and make it possible to start the game from scratch. 

Thanks for your support, we really appreciate it!

notes.title: Hotfix 2 (3.0.6) release notes
notes.content:
Version 3.0.6 was released with plenty of fixes and changes:
[list]
[*] Time between promo offers is twice as long now (10 minutes) - it looks like we also introduced bug with more offers being offered after buying the Ultimate PC edition, we are working on fixing that
[*] Fixed wrong karma calculation
[*] Fixed graphic presets not making intended effect
[*] Fixed various crashes
[*] Fixed problems with physics (falling through floor)
[*] All nonconsumable inapps returned to player after reseting progress
[/list]

We are already working on another patch to make game more enjoyable for you!

notes.title: First hotfix released!
notes.content:
Hello, we just released the first update/hotfix. We are still trying to fix problems with framerate that some people experience but right now we have smaller enhancements and fixes:

[list]
[*] You can invert mouse Y axis 
[*] You can map missing controls (WASD)
[*] Steam edition purchase is applied even when you start the new game
[*] Balancing - basic enemies have less HP and lower damage
[*] Falling through floor in Science base fixed
[*] Enemies in T-pose fixed
[/list]
